svg.title: Verdis verdict rules
svg.desc: Seven ordered rules: unsafe attachment, needs info, duplicate, two kinds of inconclusive, reproduced or out of scope, and not reproduced.

text.font-family: 'SF Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: HOW A VERDICT IS REACHED

text.font-family: Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif

svg.text: Seven ordered rules. The first one that applies decides.

text.font-family: 'SF Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
'SF Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: UNSAFE_ATTACHMENT

text.font-family: Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif

svg.text: Preflight blocked an attachment.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif

svg.text: Nothing runs. The reasons are stated as observed behaviour, not as a judgement of the reporter.

text.font-family: 'SF Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
'SF Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: NEEDS_INFO

text.font-family: Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif

svg.text: Required evidence is missing.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif

svg.text: The affected version, the proof of concept or the steps. Your own policy clause is quoted.

text.font-family: 'SF Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
'SF Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: DUPLICATE

text.font-family: Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif

svg.text: A prior report or advisory matches above the threshold.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif

svg.text: A suggestion with reasons. It needs no run, and nothing is ever merged.

text.font-family: 'SF Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
'SF Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: INCONCLUSIVE

text.font-family: Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif

svg.text: The report names a function or file the target does not have.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif

svg.text: The claim cannot be checked, so it is never called reproduced.

text.font-family: 'SF Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
'SF Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: INCONCLUSIVE

text.font-family: Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif

svg.text: The build failed, the run timed out or flaked, or the environment is unsupported.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif

svg.text: The honest answer when the tool cannot tell.

text.font-family: 'SF Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
'SF Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: REPRODUCED

text.font-family: Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif

svg.text: An oracle fired at the claimed ref and matched the claim.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif

svg.text: Tier 1 when the impact was shown, Tier 2 when only the behaviour was.

text.font-family: 'SF Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: OUT_OF_SCOPE

text.font-family: Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif

svg.text: if your policy excludes it

text.font-family: 'SF Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
'SF Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: NOT_REPRODUCED

text.font-family: Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif

svg.text: The proof of concept ran and the claimed behaviour did not occur.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif

svg.text: It never means the code is safe. It means this run did not show the claim.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif
text.tspan: When nothing is certain the answer is
